title: Rain on the radar
description: data of: rain.py --json. The nearest rain on RainViewer's composite radar round the site, its movement, and when rain upwind reaches the site and for how long.

picture.description: HH:MM local, the radar picture's time.

picture_at.description: The radar picture's time, ISO with zone; arrival minutes count from it.

nearest_km.description: null: no rain on the map (about 250 km each way).

rain_share.description: Fraction of the map with rain.

movement_from.description: Whether the movement is the rain's own, the satellite's cloud, or the model's 700 hPa wind hour by hour; with the cloud layer whose wind it matches.

own_movement.description: The radar's or satellite's own reading when it matched no layer's wind and the model's was used instead.

moving_from.description: Compass point the rain comes from.

arrives_min.description: Minutes until rain upwind reaches the site, from the radar picture; 0 now; null none within 4 h.

arrives_in_min.description: The same counted from now (the picture's age taken off): what a warning goes by.

age_min.description: How old the radar's newest picture was when looked at.

stale.description: The picture older than STALE_MIN: history, never said as the rain now.

lasts_min.description: Minutes the rain lasts on the track; null when its end is beyond the map.
